# Location (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Location` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 4 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-ref-location) | `GET /ref/location?ID={ID}&Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Deprecated={Deprecated}&Name={Name}` |
| [POST](#post-ref-location) | `POST /ref/location` |
| [PUT](#put-ref-location) | `PUT /ref/location` |
| [DELETE](#delete-ref-location) | `DELETE /ref/location?ID={ID}` |


Location CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Location
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `ID`  | Guid           |         | Yes* |   Required for PUT and DELETE, Ignored for POST operations       |
| `Name`  | String             | 50        | Yes | Location name     |
| `IsDefault`  | Bool             |         |          | Points that location is used as default       |
| `Deprecated`  | Bool             |         |          | Points that location is deprecated            |
| `Bins`  | Array          |         |          | Array (ID, Name) with related Bins            |
| `FixedAssetsLocation`  | Bool             |         |          | Points that location is used as Fixed Asset |
| `ParentID`  | Guid             |         |          | Parent ID (used for Bins) |
| `ReferenceCount`  | Int             |        |          | Reference linked to current location |
| `AddressLine1`  | String             | 50        |          | Address line |
| `AddressLine2`  | String             | 50        |          | Address line second |
| `AddressCitySuburb`  | String             | 50        |          | City suburb |
| `AddressStateProvince`  | String             | 50        |          | State province |
| `AddressZipPostCode`  | String             | 50        |          | Zip post code |
| `AddressCountry`  | String             | 50        |          | Country |
| `PickZones`  | String             | 50        |          | Pick zones |
| `IsShopfloor`  | Bool             |         |          | Points that location is shopfloor|
| `IsCoMan`  | Bool             |         |          | Points that location is location of co-manufacturer |
| `IsStaging`  | Bool             |         |          | Points that location is staging. It is used only for Bins. |

## Location

Path: `/ref/location`

<a id="get-ref-location"></a>
### GET /ref/location?ID={ID}&Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Deprecated={Deprecated}&Name={Name}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `ID` (optional, Guid): Only return location that with the specific ID
- `Deprecated` (optional, bool): Only return deprecated locations
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return locations that start with the specific name

<a id="post-ref-location"></a>
### POST /ref/location
+ Bins do not support modifying. Only creation and deletion.

Request body:

```json
{
  "Name": "Test new location",
  "AddressLine1": "Test address line",
  "AddressLine2": "Test address line 2",
  "AddressCitySuburb": "Test address city",
  "AddressStateProvince": "Test address state",
  "AddressZipPostCode": "Test address ZIP",
  "AddressCountry": "Test address country",
  "IsShopfloor": false,
  "IsCoMan": false,
  "IsStaging": false
}
```

Response 200:

```json
{
  "ID": "7e1e7cdc-eb4a-45d4-ae7f-e8999bb9dd8a",
  "Name": "Test new location",
  "IsDefault": false,
  "AllowReorder": false,
  "Bins": [],
  "PickZones": null,
  "IsDeprecated": false,
  "IsShopfloor": false,
  "IsCoMan": false,
  "IsStaging": false
}
```
